goal: Prevent descriptor imports from deriving and tracking keys before the requested range start
Fix wallet balance drops after reload caused by temporary ownership of keys below range start
Eliminate massive import slowdowns and potential node stalls for descriptors with high range starts
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Substantive support with tested ACKs and no open objections
Verified on regtest that prior keys are ignored, balances stay consistent, and speed improves (fametrano)
Verified test fails without the fix and passes with it on Mac (cprkrn)

why: P2 because it fixes a bug where transactions below range start drop out of wallet balance upon reload
Prevents node stalls and excessive derivations when importing descriptors with large range starts
